prompt.project_info: A straightforward late-afternoon street-style portrait with warm light, a graphic two-wall corner, and relaxed everyday styling.
prompt.main_subject: An adult woman in her twenties with long platinum-blonde beachy waves, light eyes, a composed neutral expression, and understated natural makeup. She wears a fitted white ribbed short-sleeve top, dark charcoal high-waisted straight-leg jeans, a brown distressed suede shoulder bag, silver beaded bracelets, and a small silver ring.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical knee-up portrait at a slightly low eye-level angle. She leans casually into the meeting point of a white painted brick wall and slate blue-grey horizontal wood siding, with one shoulder against the wall and a relaxed hand at her side. Grey asphalt is visible at the bottom; the background is empty of people, text, logos, and signage.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright golden late-afternoon sunlight from front-left, approximately 4300K, illuminates hair and face while casting soft shadows to camera-right. Keep the brick, siding, worn suede, and asphalt tactile, with visible pores and lightly tousled hair.
prompt.technical_specs: Full-frame digital camera with a 50mm lens at f/2.8, vertical 3:4 crop, knee-up frame, natural warm grading, slightly lifted blacks, subtle 35mm grain, gentle lens falloff, and realistic documentary sharpness.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Adult woman in her twenties with long platinum-blonde, loose beachy waves and understated natural makeup, standing casually against the corner of a white painted brick wall and slate blue-grey horizontal wood siding. She wears a fitted white ribbed short-sleeve top, dark charcoal high-waisted straight-leg jeans, a brown distressed suede shoulder bag, silver beaded bracelets, and a small silver ring. Her pose is relaxed and confident, face turned toward camera with a calm neutral expression. Grey asphalt at the bottom, no people or other objects in the background, bright warm golden late-afternoon sunlight from front-left, knee-up vertical street-style portrait, natural skin texture, realistic worn surfaces, 3:4 crop.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, exposed midriff, sexualized pose, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, logo, readable text, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted anatomy
